heard: The cut-taste world in our solar system is a giant snow machine. This moon, Enceladus, is just 500 kilometers across and reflects nearly all sunlight. In 2005, the Cassini spacecraft discovered massive geysers erupting from its south pole. These jets of water and organic molecules blast through warm fractures nicknamed tiger stripes. Tidal flexing from Saturn and the moon, Dione, melts a global ocean under the ice. Most of the erupting water ice falls back to the surface as fresh snow. The rest escapes into orbit to supply most of the material in Saturn's E-ring. This process continually recoats the moon in a fresh layer of blindingly white ice. That is why the cut, Ghost World and the solar system, is a giant snow machine.
